courses.title: Social Media Content Strategy in Practice
courses.description: By the end of Social Media Content Strategy in Practice, you'll be able to apply social media content strategy confidently in Communications Specialist work, with a working sense of where content calendar planning fits alongside it. The course moves from core social media content strategy technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at content calendar planning woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying social media content strategy to a real Communications Specialist scenario
Practicing social media content strategy through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to content calendar planning
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Crisis Communication
courses.description: Applying Crisis Communication goes beyond the basics of crisis communication, for people already working toward a Communications Specialist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in crisis communication and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying crisis communication to a real Communications Specialist scenario
Practicing crisis communication through guided exercises
Building a short crisis communication exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
